name: NSM
breaks_up: an NSM (Narrow Small Model): one that does a single job and answers with a kind, a span, an item, a number or codes, never with sentences, and leaves the decision to code; narrow is the size of its answer, not of the model
left_out: A model that writes. Anything that writes sentences for people is not an NSM: an NSM answers with a kind, a span, an item, a number or codes, and code decides what follows. Also left out: what the NSM is for in the world, its name, and the keys, which stay with the person who keyed them.

element_types.name: does
element_types.description: The one thing the model does. A larger task is split into steps first, each done by its own model or by code.

elements.name: sorts
elements.description: puts each thing it reads into one of a few kinds set in advance
elements.gives: It puts each thing it reads into one of a few kinds set in advance.

elements.name: points
elements.description: finds the part of what it reads that answers a question, or says there is none
elements.gives: It points at the part of what it reads that answers a question, or at nothing.

elements.name: matches
elements.description: says which item on a list written in advance the thing it reads goes with
elements.gives: It says which item on a list written in advance the thing it reads goes with.

elements.name: spots
elements.description: says which of a set of words or sounds recorded in advance occurred
elements.gives: It says which of the words or sounds recorded in advance occurred.

elements.name: scores
elements.description: gives each option a number, and code takes the highest
elements.gives: It gives each option a number, and code takes the highest.

elements.name: chooses
elements.description: picks codes from sets, one slot at a time
elements.gives: It picks codes from sets, one slot at a time.

element_types.name: reads
element_types.description: What goes into the model each time it answers.

elements.name: a sentence
elements.description: one sentence at a time
elements.gives: It reads one sentence at a time.

elements.name: two sentences
elements.description: two sentences read together, such as a question and its answer

elements.name: a passage
elements.description: a few sentences up to a page, with a question about it
elements.gives: It reads a passage of a few sentences up to a page.

elements.name: a whole text
elements.description: a whole text, shortened to fit the model's window
elements.gives: It reads a whole text, shortened to fit its window.

elements.name: a second of sound
elements.description: a second or two of sound from a microphone
elements.gives: It hears a second or two of sound at a time.

elements.name: numbers
elements.description: a few whole numbers that describe a situation
elements.gives: It reads a few numbers that describe a situation.

elements.name: codes
elements.description: numbers that stand for words, never the words themselves
elements.gives: It reads only codes that stand for words, never the words.

element_types.name: answers with
element_types.description: What comes out. Every answer can also be none, which code reads as don’t know.

elements.name: a kind
elements.description: one of a few kinds set in advance
elements.gives: It answers with one of the kinds, or none.

elements.name: yes or no
elements.description: one of two answers
elements.gives: It answers yes or no, or none.

elements.name: a span
elements.description: where an answer starts and ends in what it read
elements.gives: It answers with where the answer starts and ends, or none.

elements.name: an item
elements.description: one item from a list written in advance
elements.gives: It answers with one item from the list, or none.

elements.name: a number
elements.description: a number for each option, which code compares
elements.gives: It answers with a number for each option.

elements.name: codes
elements.description: codes chosen from sets, which code turns back into words
elements.gives: It answers with codes, which code turns back into words.

element_types.name: starts from
element_types.description: The trained model it begins from, before it learns the job.

elements.name: a pointing reader
elements.description: MiniLM, 33 million parameters, already trained to find the answer to a question in a passage

elements.name: an encoder with a new head
elements.description: MiniLM, 33 million parameters, with a small new layer that picks one of a few kinds

elements.name: an adapter on a trained model
elements.description: a small set of added weights trained on top of a model already trained for a nearby job

elements.name: a multilingual encoder
elements.description: a small encoder that reads several languages, retrained on Indian languages

elements.name: a frozen audio encoder
elements.description: a model trained on sound, kept as it is, with a small scorer trained on top

elements.name: a keyword spotter
elements.description: a tiny encoder, tens to hundreds of thousands of parameters, that compares sound with recorded examples

elements.name: nothing
elements.description: no trained model: every weight is learnt from the start

elements.name: a few whole numbers
elements.description: no neural network: a handful of whole numbers that multiply the inputs

element_types.name: learns from
element_types.description: Where the right answers it learns from come from.

elements.name: your own keys
elements.description: your own answers, given one item at a time on sheets that show no model’s answer

elements.name: a rule you stated
elements.description: answers code works out from a rule you stated in words

elements.name: rows a model wrote
elements.description: rows another model wrote for training, the right answer known from how each was made

elements.name: another model's labels
elements.description: labels another model gave, used on your word

elements.name: a dataset's labels
elements.description: the labels a public dataset came with

element_types.name: runs on
element_types.description: Where the model answers once it is trained.

elements.name: a Raspberry Pi 5
elements.description: inside a toy or a game, on its processor, with nothing sent anywhere

elements.name: a phone's browser
elements.description: in the page itself, with nothing sent to a server

elements.name: a small server
elements.description: a server's processor with no graphics card, such as one with 1 CPU and 2 GB

elements.name: a graphics card
elements.description: a machine with a graphics card, such as an RTX 3060 with 12 GB

instances.name: ungli
instances.what: a builder: design a task as steps of NSMs (Narrow Small Models) and plain code, and read beside each model what the nearest models already built were measured to do and what their records say to check. Its name is from ungli rakhna, to put a finger on the exact spot, which is all a model here does

described_entities.name: mom, a base trained from scratch
